description: The side panel's Side questions page: /btw questions asked about the conversation without adding to it. A box on top asks a new one; below, one row per question, newest first, each opening its thread under its line or filling the page. Each question is its own throwaway claude that sees the whole conversation so far but writes nothing, can't edit anything and can't use tools that need permission.
opens: /btw <question> typed in the chat's composer and sent (works even mid-turn; doesn't interrupt; the composer is emptied; the panel opens on this page with the new question open under its line). /btw with nothing after it does nothing.

parts.name: new question box
parts.shows: At the top of the list page, a rounded text box (a pill) at least as tall as an empty list placeholder, growing taller as more is typed, with a send button by the text's last line. Edge to edge with the list under it, 10px above it. The send button and Ctrl+Enter do nothing while the box is empty (the button is greyed).

actions.by: key Ctrl+Enter / ⌘Enter, or click send (tooltip "Ask (Ctrl+Enter)" with "New line: Enter" on a second line)
actions.does: asks it: a new row at the top of the list, open under its line; the box is emptied. If the question couldn't be asked, the row is dropped, the text stays in the box and the window's note says "the side question couldn't be asked: <why>"
a new line (a list's next item inside a list; Shift+Enter a plain line break)
indent or outdent a list item

decisions.said: Try a text box at the top of Side questions instead of a +, in its own pill the size of the empty-state pill, with Enter doing nothing while it's empty.
decisions.rule: Every app asks a new side question from a box at the top of the list, a pill at least as tall as an empty list's placeholder, apart from the threads under it; sending does nothing while it's empty.

decisions.said: The side question input was slightly shorter than the artifact and empty-state heights it should match
decisions.rule: Every app draws the side-question box at least as tall as the side panel's empty-list placeholders (Artifacts, Subagents, Processes), so the pages line up.

decisions.said: The side questions' send button should be centred with the text and stay bottom-right as lines are added (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: In every app the side questions' send button sits level with the text's last line, moving down as lines are added and staying in the bottom-right corner once the box is full

parts.name: list
parts.shows: A boxed list of questions, newest first. Hidden entirely (no outline) while none has been asked, so only the box shows.

parts.name: row line
parts.shows: Left to right: a status mark, the question as the title (wraps over lines, not bold), a ⌄ toggle and a maximise button. The status mark is shown only while it's answering (spinner), or for a failed question (red cross) or a stopped one (grey stop mark); otherwise nothing.

parts.name: status
parts.shows: Spinner while it answers; red cross if the answer failed; grey stop mark if stopped or the process ended mid-answer; hidden otherwise.

parts.name: title
parts.shows: The first question's text (what was asked), wrapping.

parts.name: toggle
parts.shows: ⌄ (down chevron) when closed, − when open; tooltip "Show this side question" / "Hide this side question".

actions.does: slides the thread open or closed under the line

parts.name: maximise
parts.shows: Window-maximise icon, tooltip "Open this side question in the whole panel".
text: Open this side question in the whole panel

actions.does: the row grows into a page filling the panel

parts.name: opened thread (under the line)
parts.shows: On a darker inside inset from the row: the thread (the answer as a markdown reply, then each follow-up as a user bubble followed by its answer), nothing at all above the box until something has been asked; then under it the box for a follow-up, the composer's (Composer): one line tall wrapped close round its send button (a stop button while answering). Scrolls past nine lines of typing. No dots or context meter here.

actions.does: asks the follow-up in the same claude; the box is emptied (kept if it couldn't be sent)

actions.by: key Esc while answering, or the box's stop button
actions.does: stops the answer; shown as stopped (grey stop mark), not failed

actions.by: revert button on a follow-up's user bubble (not on the first question; not on Codex models; not while answering)
actions.does: that follow-up and everything after it is hidden and its text put in the box to change; Esc puts it back with the earlier draft; sending it rewinds the conversation, then asks. If refused: note "Couldn't revert the side question's follow-up: <why>"

parts.name: full page (detail)
parts.shows: Header over the thread. Header: status mark (as in the row), the question as one ellipsised line, a back button ‹ (tooltip "All side questions") at the end. Under it the thread fills the page and scrolls; at its foot the same box (one line tall till more is typed, scrolls vertically if long), and under the box working dots on the left while it answers and a context meter (how much of the model's window the question's context uses, e.g. "24k / 200k") at the right, refreshed about once a second while answering and after each answer.

actions.does: closes into its row (into its thread under the line, if it was open there)

actions.by: same keys as the opened thread
actions.does: Ctrl+Enter asks, Esc stops, Ctrl+F finds

parts.name: answer content
parts.shows: Answers are rendered as markdown replies, streaming in. A side question is told to answer briefly from what it already knows. An answer that fails shows the error text in italics (or "The side question failed."). A request to use a tool that needs permission is refused automatically ("Side questions can't run tools that need permission.") and not shown as a prompt.

states.name: empty
states.shows: Only the new-question box; no list, no placeholder text.

states.name: answering
states.shows: Spinner in the row/header, the box's send button turns to stop, dots under the box on the full page

states.name: failed
states.shows: Red cross, the error in italics as the answer

states.name: couldn't start
states.shows: The row keeps its question in its own box to send again; its claude starts then. The window's note says why (e.g. claude missing or the chat's folder gone).

states.name: several at once
states.shows: Any number can run at the same time; each has its own row and spinner

removed.name: 'New side question' title on a question not yet asked
removed.why: The owner asked to drop the 'New side question' copy.

removed.name: "No side questions" placeholder
removed.why: The owner: not needed; the new-question box fills the empty space well enough (other empty states stay)
